newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was fair. Seller interest light.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs - couple loads 103.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs - pen 64.50; couple loads 103.00. Confirmed - 300 Last Week - 42,800 Last Year - 1,100 Week To Date - 10,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 50,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 7,600
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
